title.zh: US seizes $61M of Iranian crypto profits allegedly laundered through Binance
title.en: US seizes $61M of Iranian crypto profits allegedly laundered through Binance

current_state.zh: The US filed a civil forfeiture complaint to seize $61 million in crypto allegedly linked to Iranian oil sales laundered through Binance by two Chinese companies, as part of a broader $1.5 billion illicit proceeds scheme.
current_state.en: The US filed a civil forfeiture complaint to seize $61 million in crypto allegedly linked to Iranian oil sales laundered through Binance by two Chinese companies, as part of a broader $1.5 billion illicit proceeds scheme.
